She is a member of the UNESCO Global Expert Panel on the 2005 Convention on Cultural Expressions and as part of this role, she has delivered global research and advisory support to state parties on emerging technologies (including AI) in the global creative industries. She is a member of UNESCO’s Global Reference Group on Diversity of Cultural Expressions in the Digital Environment - supporting the development of frameworks for supporting the sector in the age of technologies like AI.
